title: Filters
summary: Light added to a dark room, shown on the sample clip under the theme's night look (as footage in this theme normally is): the night look itself, the red/blue echo split, the red-dot origin flare, the blue result flash, a sweeping line of light, a hard-lock frame, light trails, lilac bloom and scanline haze, plus a few quiet shared treatments. Previews run at full strength; use less in a video.
usage: In a footage storyboard: {"footage": {"look": {"name": "night", "amount": 0.9}}} and {"name": "origin_flare", "at": 2.4, "seconds": 0.6, "amount": 0.9}. On a shot candidate: {"effect": {"name": "rgb_echo", "amount": 0.8, "where": "in", "seconds": 0.4}}. This theme's own effects: library/themes/lines-of-light/effects/theme_effects.py; grain, vignette, halation, chromatic, scanlines and zoom_blur come from library/_shared/effects_engine.py.

items.name: night
items.description: The theme look (footage.look, about 0.9): the room drops to near-black deep teal with a soft vignette while a centre-weighted falloff keeps the speaker lit, cool and readable, so lines of light read like v1.

items.name: Dim
items.description: Turns the footage's brightness down by the amount (0-1; 1 = 85% darker), toward the theme's near-black teal. No other change, so it stacks with the night look, lighting effects and anything else; use it under overlays on a bright room or across a whole clip.

items.name: lilac bloom
items.description: Highlights bloom into the theme's cold lilac halo and shadows sink to teal. Holds for a whole shot.

items.name: origin flare
items.description: The red dot fires: a red flare blooms from the top-left origin with thin rays fanning into the frame. Red = the cause.

items.name: result flash
items.description: Blue = the result arriving: a soft blue flash swells from the bottom middle and a thin ring of light opens out of it.

items.name: line sweep
items.description: One line of light (white core, red echo above, blue below) sweeps down the frame and lights what it passes.

items.name: lock flash
items.description: The hard lock: a split red/blue frame of light snaps on round the picture and dims. Use 'in' on a cut.

items.name: rgb echo
items.description: The style's split on the picture itself: bright edges get a red echo one way, a blue echo the other and a white-lilac core.

items.name: light trails
items.description: Afterimages: the brightest parts leave fading red echoes behind and blue ahead, like a line still moving after the lock.

items.name: scan haze
items.description: Teal haze drifting over fine scanlines with a slow bright scan band: the screen the lines are drawn on. Quiet enough to hold.

items.name: halation
items.description: Shared: a soft glow bleeding off the brightest areas.

items.name: chromatic
items.description: Shared: colour channels pull apart toward the edges of the frame.

items.name: zoom blur
items.description: Shared: a radial streak toward the centre, for a push on a turn in the argument.

items.name: vignette
items.description: Shared: darker corners, the light pooling in the middle.

items.name: grain
items.description: Shared: fine film grain, as on the theme's title cards.

items.name: scanlines
items.description: Shared: plain horizontal scanlines.

items.name: spotlight
items.description: A warm pool of light from above on the person; the room falls away to near-black. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: rim light
items.description: Dark, cool scene; a thin bright outline traces the person. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: flashlight
items.description: A hard round beam on the face that drifts a little; everything else dark. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: golden hour
items.description: Low warm sun with leaf shadows dappled across the scene. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: neon
items.description: Hot magenta from one side, a cyan touch from the other, dark in between. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: projector
items.description: A bright lamp flaring behind the head through haze, teal room. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: under light
items.description: Light from below: the campfire or horror look. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: low key
items.description: Mostly shadow: one small key on the face, deep blacks. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: silhouette
items.description: Bright hazy background, the person a dark shape with a faint edge. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: cop lights
items.description: The room drops dark and red and blue police lights strobe across the person from both sides. Options ("props"): color, color2 (hex), speed (flashes per second, 2.2), push (1.08).

items.name: colour grade
items.description: The look changes on a word: moody, warm, cool, black and white or pop fades in (or ripples out from a point). Options ("props"): grade (moody, warm, cool, bw, pop), style (fade or ripple), dur (seconds to arrive), x, y (ripple origin, 0–1). Also works as a footage "look".
